bloc.Aucun plafond n’est posé. Les plafonds s: No cap is set. Caps are passed to /api/finops through the seuils parameter, per cost centre — a cap is a committee decision, revised each financial year, and freezing it in a table would mean a migration every time a number changes.
bloc.Bloc # sur # · Empreinte IA du parc — Ve: Block # of # · AI footprint of the estate — Locked
bloc.Ce que coûte le parc que vous avez déjà: What the estate you have already declared costs. This page keeps no inventory of its own: it reads the AI systems register — the same one compliance uses. The attribution FinOps demands (owner, department, purpose) is already there, and it is the costliest half of the exercise.
bloc.Ce que pèse le parc de systèmes d’IA que: What the estate of AI systems you have already declared in the Register weighs. This page keeps no inventory of its own: the same declared volume gives the cost when divided by a rate, and the energy when multiplied by watt-hours per thousand tokens. A second inventory, kept alongside, would diverge from the first within a month.
bloc.Ces champs se saisissent sur la fiche du: These fields are entered on the system record, in the Register. None is guessed: a fine-tuning campaign cannot be estimated from a usage volume.
bloc.Chaque montant porte sa formule chiffrée: Each amount carries its costed formula and the provenance of the volume. An amount whose volume cannot be traced to its source is not defensible in a steering committee.
bloc.Déclarés, jamais mesurés : cette page ne: Declared, never measured: this page cannot know whether a cache is actually connected. What it contributes is the question asked on every line — a box never ticked across twenty lines shows, the absence of the question does not.

bloc.HYPOTHÈSE DU CABINET. Ordre de grandeur: THE FIRM'S ASSUMPTION. The usual order of magnitude in the literature on the energy intensity of fixed networks, whose published values span more than an order of magnitude depending on the scope taken (core only, or core + access + device). · hypothese_cabinet
bloc.La classification vient du Simulateur IA: The classification comes from the AI Act simulator and the AI register: it is not asked for again here. The order follows the Regulation, never the headcounts — a single high-risk system is read before fifteen minimal-risk systems.
bloc.L’inférence et l’ajustement fin sont ren: Inference and fine-tuning are reported separately. Mixing them would make the term disappear that, on an estate that fine-tunes its models, is often the heaviest.
bloc.Règlement délégué (UE) #/# de la Commiss: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) #/# of # December # revising the primary energy factor for electricity, Annex — replaces note # of Annex IV to Directive #/#/EU. CELEX #R#. · texte_reglementaire
bloc.Servis par le moteur, jamais recopiés ic: Served by the engine, never copied here — otherwise the screen and the code would drift apart, and it is the screen you would believe. Each carries its nature: regulatory text, reading, or the firm’s assumption.
bloc.Un indicateur absent est déclaré absent,: A missing indicator is declared missing, with what it would take to establish it. Filling it with a number that has no author would be worse than showing nothing.
bloc.Une case cochée dit qu’un levier est déc: A ticked box says that a lever is declared, never that it is connected: this page cannot verify it.
bloc.Une heuristique, jamais un verdict : « c: A heuristic, never a verdict: “this model is too big” assumes you know the expected quality, the tolerated error rate and what an error costs. The rank gap says where to look.

Nothing is measured: Sentinel does not run inside your applications. The volumes come from your register, and a system nobody entered there weighs nothing here — which does not mean it consumes nothing.
bloc.coûts hors modèle — Stockage vectoriel,: costs beyond the model — Vector storage, orchestration, monitoring, human review time: these items are real and absent here. A model cost is not a use-case cost.
bloc.extraction — Extraction ou classificatio: extraction — Extraction or classification on short text
bloc.forfait — montant fixe, indépendant de l: forfait — a fixed amount, independent of usage
bloc.remises et contrats — Un contrat entrepr: discounts and contracts — An enterprise contract, a volume discount, a context cache or deferred processing change the real cost, sometimes by an order of magnitude. The module does not know them and does not guess them.
bloc.requetes — facturé à la requête, quel qu: requetes — billed per request, whatever its size
bloc.tarifs autres editeurs — Les tarifs d'Op: other vendors' prices — The prices of OpenAI, Google, Mistral, Meta and of open-model hosts are not in the table: they are not recorded here. Adding them means transcribing the published price, its currency, the date it was read and its address — not estimating it.
bloc.taux de change — Aucun taux n'est appliq: exchange rate — No rate is applied. Amounts come out in dollars where the price is in dollars. Converting assumes a dated rate, and an invented rate would produce a wrong amount with a precise look.

texte.Aucun fournisseur ne publie la consommat: No provider publishes the actual consumption of a request. The volumes come from your register, the factors carry their source and their nature, and nothing is estimated on your behalf. Draw from it neither a neutrality claim nor avoided emissions.

texte.Le coût d'usage n'est qu'une part du coû: Usage cost is only part of the real cost: risk management, technical documentation, logging and conformity assessment carry another part, which this module does not cost.
texte.Le fournisseur est déclaré, le modèle no: The provider is declared, the model is not: the price can be read from a named vendor. It is the cheapest gap to close in the batch.
texte.Le niveau de risque au sens du règlement: The risk level within the meaning of Regulation (EU) #/#. A euro spent on a high-risk system does not read like a euro spent on a minimal-risk system: the first carries obligations that have a cost of their own.
texte.Le seul levier que le client actionne se: The only lever the client pulls alone, without changing anything else.
texte.Le terme d’hébergement vaut # Wh par REQ: The hosting term is worth # Wh per REQUEST. These systems declare tokens: the number of calls is unknown, and deriving it from an average response length would bring in a figure nobody declared. Their method C therefore carries the manufacturing uplift alone. Declare the billing unit « requests » wherever that is the case, so they can be counted in full.

texte.Ne change RIEN à l'électricité consommée: Changes NOTHING in the electricity consumed or in primary energy: it only shifts emissions. Mistaking it for an efficiency gain is the most common error.
